items.title: Core architecture
items.description: A modular, extensible architecture with clear boundaries between repository discovery, analysis, issue management and operations.

items.title: Repository management
items.description: Registering and managing repositories, including their local paths and operational state.

items.title: Repository scanning and discovery
items.description: Configurable repository scanning with progress tracking and persisted scan records.

items.title: File fingerprinting
items.description: Content fingerprinting and manifest-based incremental scanning for efficient change detection.

items.title: Review engine architecture
items.description: An extensible analyser and analysis-engine contract for introducing new languages and review types.

items.title: Language-specific analysers
items.description: A Roslyn-based C# analyser maps code symbols into a structured model. C# is the initial language focus.

items.title: AI-powered code review
items.description: AI-assisted review engines apply configured prompts to repository contents via OpenAI-compatible APIs.

items.title: Structured issue generation
items.description: Findings are persisted with category, severity and status, and reconciled against the current state of the code.

items.title: Issue browsing and filtering
items.description: Browse and inspect findings through the web interface.

items.title: Issue details and review context
items.description: Inspect the reasoning and context behind each finding.

items.title: Priority-based presentation
items.description: Findings are classified and presented with severity and priority, with configurable severity rules.

items.title: Independent AI issue validation
items.description: A separate validation workflow re-checks findings against repository context.

items.title: Review engine separation
items.description: Review and validation responsibilities are separated into distinct workflows.

items.title: Validation tooling
items.description: Background workers drive validation, duplicate detection and reconciliation.

items.title: Human confirmation of resolved issues
items.description: Explicit human confirmation of resolved findings is being considered for a future phase.

items.title: Administration dashboard
items.description: An operational dashboard with live status of repositories, findings and processing.

items.title: System health monitoring
items.description: Health checks, readiness reporting and uptime monitoring.

items.title: Reliability and recovery
items.description: Recovery from interrupted processing on startup with resilient background workers.

items.title: Retry handling and operational visibility
items.description: Retry handling with exponential backoff, processing gates and operational diagnostics.

items.title: Additional review types
items.description: Introduce new review types for additional engineering concerns.

items.title: Missing unit test detection
items.description: Detect source modules that lack corresponding tests.

items.title: AI-assisted test generation
items.description: Generate test cases with AI assistance where a gap is identified.

items.title: Additional language analysers
items.description: Extend analysis beyond C# to additional languages.

items.title: Expanded validation capabilities
items.description: Broaden independent validation across more finding types and contexts.
